title: Oozy Fluffy Russian Semolina Fritters
description: These mustardy, fluffy fritters are a delicious and adventurous Russian dish featuring semolina flour, perfect for a snack or dessert. They are deep-fried to a golden brown and are plant-based-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine semolina flour, all-purpose flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together plant-based milk, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, and warm water.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Add the active dry yeast and stir gently to combine.
Let the batter rest in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Heat the canola oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and puffed up.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters warm and enjoy.
